title: Christmas Open House
seo_title: Christmas Open House at Kaitlynn Bray Aesthetics, Bolivar
description: Kaitlynn Bray Aesthetics & Laser hosts a Christmas open house with holiday specials, including 25% off gift cards (in-office purchases only), EPIONCE skincare bundle deals, and $8 Tox with Ashley, no appointment needed. Visitors can also get complimentary 5-minute chair massages with Muriel, join an Aroma Designs workshop with a custom perfume bar, and enter raffles and giveaways, with snacks and drinks provided. It runs Friday, December 4, 2026, from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM at 2075 S Boston Pl in Bolivar, MO.
